messages.subject: Aux-cache blocker: target reuse across different patients/microbatches
messages.body: RegionManager.targets computes current_hash but can_use_cache never compares it (regions.py around570-590); only shape/cadence matter. Exact repro manager mode=ema refresh_every5, patientA step0 target class1 then patientB step1 target class2 with different images/spacing returns the SAME RegionTargets object and class1. Need identity-keyed bounded cache including image/support/geometry/config and explicit teacher refresh policy, not sampled-hash/current shape; route to region owner/other reviewer. Separately same module defaults missing physical metadata to isotropic1mm instead of failing closed.

messages.subject: Accumulation objective differs for aux losses
messages.body: Independent Toy Conv3d test: volume_mean, pseudo_threshold1 (zero accepted), temporal identity weight2, B2 with valid supports24 and2, same logical batch/model/init. accumulation1 versus2 gives different pseudo/temporal loss and pseudo gradients because engine weights whole chunk_pseudo_loss+chunk_aux by pseudo accepted count (fallback1), while temporal objective reduces valid voxels and region objective reduces volumes.
